source_policy: Derived statistics only; original Softimage assets from bz2_art.7z are not committed.

scope.important: This census is deliberately separate from the smaller nested Archival.zip high-resolution validation set. Conclusions inferred from the nested subset must not be treated as universal across the full source archive.

raw_txmp_plus24.conclusion: The full outer archive uses +24 codes 1 through 8 except no additional values. Codes 6, 7 and 8 are therefore real source states and any 1..5-only table is subset-scoped rather than universal.

relation_code_400.correction_to_nested_subset: The nested Archival.zip high-resolution set had 403 resolved code-400 edges using only 1..5 with identity +90. The full outer archive instead contains model-local codes 6 and 8 plus 54 meaningful nonidentity +90 records. The working high-resolution 1..5 identity path remains useful but is not a universal code-400 decoder.

relation_code_401.special_mode_correction: Code 7 is exceptionally strong reflection/environment evidence in the full outer archive: 93/93 resolved code-401 edges use reflection3. Code 8 is also environment-associated in the outer archive (reflection3/reflection/backgr), so the nested walker glass/cavern association was a subset-specific usage rather than a universal code-8 meaning.

auxiliary_word_correction.retraction: The earlier nested-archive observation that +78=1 was exclusive to +24=5 does not hold across the full source archive. +78 must not be used as evidence that code 5 means Cylindrical. +76/+78/+80 remain raw auxiliary state until source-correlated semantics are recovered.

repeat_state.note: The full archive further reinforces +2/+4 as URepeat/VRepeat because repeat values vary broadly and coherently across thousands of ordinary assets. Detailed repeat validation remains in txmp_repeat_summary.json.

working_high_res_subset_table.5: legacy high-resolution subset working mapping only

projection_operator_policy.full_archive_policy: Do not apply one global 1..5 sequential enum table to all BZ2 source generations. Preserve +24 raw, apply only explicitly supported/scoped working mappings, and defer codes/states whose semantics are not independently anchored. The full archive demonstrates code 6 and 8 on model-local projections and invalidates the former +78-based code-5 cylindrical argument.
